Pose - Neutral Standing.description:
🕴️ Pose: Neutral Standing
Relaxed upright stance with natural posture. No particular action or emotion — a versatile, default portrait position.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Neutral Standing.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, use an upright neutral stance with level shoulders, straight posture, balanced weight, and relaxed frame-visible arms and open or loosely curled hands. Female: shoulders level, weight even with one hip barely settled. Male: shoulders level, weight square through both legs. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own resting carriage.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
